name: Lina Haddad

old_letters: Dear Hiring Team, I am a computer science student in Darmstadt and I enjoy turning complex technical topics into clear explanations. In my current working student role I produce tutorial videos and documentation in English and German. I would be glad to bring this experience to your team. Kind regards, Lina Haddad
